description.value: Shirley Delicious is a celebrated little cafe tucked in the rainforest on the Pacific Marine Circle Route, roughly 20 minutes west of Sooke on western Vancouver Island. Everything on the menu is made in-house — from housemade focaccia and butter croissants to brunch plates and daily soups — served alongside Fernwood Coffee and local artisan teas and kombuchas. Rated 13th overall in Canada by Yelp (the highest-ranking eatery on Vancouver Island), it draws cyclists and adventurers looking for a genuine quality stop amid the wilderness.

address.value: 2794 Sheringham Point Road, Shirley, BC, V9Z 1G4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is a real, open-year-round cafe on the Pacific Marine Circle Route west of Sooke. The self-serve patio station explicitly lists 'hydration' alongside milks and sweeteners, providing positive evidence for water bottle refill. The kitchen menu features cooked-to-order brunch and lunch items (egg dishes, panini-pressed sandwiches, soups), confirming hot food; no mention of bike parking, washrooms, or other amenities was found in the site content.
concerns: No phone number in OSM tags and none found on the website — no phone contact available for this business.
OSM category via shop=bakery maps to Groceries but the business is a cafe/restaurant; this may mislead directory users expecting a grocery store.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, year-round cafe on the Pacific Marine Circle Route with strong evidence of current operation; highly relevant to touring cyclists as a food and drink stop.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM shop=bakery is mapped to Groceries, but the business is primarily a sit-down cafe serving brunch, lunch, baked goods, and specialty coffee; a 'Cafe' or 'Food & Drink' category would more accurately reflect the offering.

Water bottle refill.detail: Website states 'a self serve station for all your milks, sweeteners and hydration located on our patio' — 'hydration' indicates potable water is available at the patio self-serve station

Hot food.detail: Full brunch and lunch menu cooked to order: egg dishes, panini-pressed sandwiches, soups, hash browns, and corn fritters served from the kitchen
